items.title: 永久免费开源声明：唯一官方发布渠道为 GitHub Releases
items.body: CreditDaddy 是永久免费开源软件（AGPL-3.0），没有付费版。任何付费购买的版本均非官方，请立即申请退款并向平台举报倒卖卖家。
items.titleEn: Free & open-source notice: GitHub Releases is the only official channel
items.bodyEn: CreditDaddy is permanently free and open-source (AGPL-3.0) with no paid edition. Any copy you paid for is unofficial — request a refund immediately and report the reseller.

items.title: 豆包每日签到仅限个人账号，飞书企业号不支持
items.body: 豆包激励任务仅面向个人账号开放，飞书企业账号无法参与；若触发风控拦截（710010702），无需重新登录，在面板点「打开豆包」由客户端完成当日签到即可（较新版本会自动调起客户端代点，无需手动）。
items.titleEn: Doubao daily check-in supports personal accounts only (Feishu enterprise excluded)
items.bodyEn: Doubao's check-in campaign is limited to personal accounts — Feishu enterprise accounts are not eligible. If risk control triggers (710010702) you don't need to sign in again: click "Open Doubao" in the panel and check in inside the client (newer builds launch it and tap check-in for you).

items.title: 支持与 10Router 联动：一键同步账号、用量与外部额度卡
items.body: 在「10Router」页签填写地址与虚拟 Key 后，可把本机托管账号、真实用量（ZCode / OpenCode / mirasim / 妙手 / Croli 等）与外部免费额度卡（Token Harbor / MiniMax / 小米 MiMo / River / ModelScope / LongCat 等）同步至 10Router。
items.titleEn: 10Router integration: one-click account, usage and quota-card sync
items.bodyEn: Configure your 10Router endpoint and virtual key in the 10Router tab to sync managed accounts, real usage (ZCode, OpenCode, mirasim, CatPaw, Croli, etc.) and external free quota cards (Token Harbor, MiniMax, Xiaomi MiMo, River, ModelScope, LongCat, etc.) to 10Router.
